jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.

You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.

The role:

We're hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to help execute and scale Coram's demand generation programs. We're looking for someone who is hands-on, moves fast, takes ownership, and knows how to turn ideas into campaigns that drive pipeline and revenue.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation Lead on strategy while owning day-to-day campaign execution, optimization, reporting, and cross-functional projects. This is a role for someone who likes being in the details, launching campaigns, digging into performance, testing new ideas, and finding ways to use AI and automation to move faster and get better results.

Responsibilities:

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube, and emerging channels.

  • Own campaign execution across keywords, audiences, bidding, budgets, copy, creative, landing pages, and conversion tracking.

  • Connect performance across the full funnel, from search query and lead through opportunity, pipeline, and revenue.

  • Analyze campaign and funnel data, identify performance gaps, and turn insights into clear actions that improve efficiency and results.

  • Write ad copy, develop creative briefs, and partner with designers, writers, developers, freelancers, and other teams to bring campaigns to life.

  • Run structured experiments across messaging, audiences, creative, landing pages, offers, and campaign strategies.

  • Manage projects from brief through launch, owning timelines, dependencies, quality checks, and follow-through.

  • Build AI-powered workflows that automate repetitive work and allow the marketing team to execute and iterate faster.

  • Use AI for research, data analysis, reporting, copy development, creative ideation, and campaign optimization.

  • Partner with marketing operations and technical teams to improve tracking, attribution, workflows, and data quality.

  • Stay focused on the metrics that matter, pipeline, revenue, and business outcomes—not vanity metrics.

Skills and qualifications:

  • 5-7 years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or demand generation, ideally within B2B SaaS or a fast-growing startup

  • Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and working knowledge of Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid acquisition channels

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect campaign performance to opportunities, pipeline, and revenue

  • Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, attribution, and CRM reporting

  • Practical experience using LLMs and AI tools for creative development, copywriting, research, analysis, and campaign optimization

  • Strong copywriting skills and creative judgment, with the ability to recognize what will resonate with an audience

  • Experience running structured tests across messaging, creative, audiences, landing pages, and campaign strategies

  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and cross-functional projects without constant supervision

  • Experience managing and collaborating with freelancers, agencies, or external partners

  • A bias toward action, you move quickly, take ownership, follow through, and are comfortable figuring things out as you go

  • Curious and resourceful, with a willingness to dig deeply into data to understand what's working and what isn't

  • Always looking for opportunities to automate, simplify, and scale how work gets done

  • Ability to work 5 days a week onsite

What we offer:

  • 100% Employer-paid medical, dental, vision, and base life insurance

  • Flexible paid time off and 10 paid holidays

  • 401(k) with both Traditional and Roth options

  • Early-stage equity in a rapidly growing company

  • Referral bonuses

  • Daily team dinners and regular team off-sites

  • The latest Apple products and unlimited tech stack (Claude Cowork, Perplexity Computer, Nooks, Clay, Instantly, etc.)

We're on a mission to transform a $50B+ legacy industry by bringing the power of cutting-edge multimodal LLMs and computer vision to real-world security and operations. From firearm detection to intelligent access control, our AI-native platform turns every camera and sensor into a smart system that enhances safety, efficiency, and awareness.

Founded by Ashesh Jain (ex-Lyft Level 5, PhD Cornell) and Peter Ondruska (ex-Lyft, PhD Oxford), Coram AI is backed by Ansa Capital, Battery Ventures, Mosaic, 8VC and Up Partners, have raised over $65M, and were named to the CB Insights AI 100 as one of the most promising AI companies in the world. If you're excited to work on mission-critical AI that makes an impact in the real world, we’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Real Time Video Streaming
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.

You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.

The role:
Coram’s platform cuts across front-end, backend, ML, and high-performance edge computing. You’ll lead major components of our edge-computing stack, with a core focus on real-time video streaming, ensuring Coram Point remains fast, reliable, and intelligent.

Responsibilities:

  • Building and optimizing real-time video streaming pipelines on our edge devices, along with the applications and communication layers that process vision data on compute-constrained hardware

  • Deploying machine learning models to production

  • Optimizing the platform runtime for maximum performance. This is largely C++ code with parts of the pipeline running on GPU

  • Building observability and telemetry

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience writing production software in C++ and Python

  • Strong experience in video processing and streaming (we use GStreamer)

  • Experience building applications processing real-time data and optimizing them for latency and memory

  • Experience using various profiling tools (e.g., gdb, Nsight, Valgrind, flame graph) to optimize the code

  • Experience with Docker, CI / CD pipelines

  • Experience in Edge/IoT computing (we have a fleet of deployed edge computers) is a plus

  • Experience in infrastructure management and monitoring (we use Salt and Grafana) is a plus

  • Experience interfacing ML models (we use PyTorch) is a plus

  • Resilient in challenging and fast-paced environments

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence at all levels

  • Ability to work in an onsite environment - we move quicker when we’re in the same room

We're hiring our first Brand & Design Lead to own how Coram looks, sounds, and feels everywhere it shows up. Right now that work is spread across the team and outside agencies. We want one person with genuine taste to own it end to end and raise the bar on all of it.

This is a leadership priority, not a logo cleanup. You'll report to the VP of Marketing and work directly with our CEO and product team on how Coram shows up in the world. Brand has a seat, not a service desk. You'll have the mandate to make bold calls and the backing to ship them. We're not hiring you to keep the brand safe. We're hiring you to make it impossible to ignore.

Responsibilities:

  • Brand identity and system. Evolve and steward Coram's visual identity: the CORAM wordmark and aperture symbol, our color and type system, illustration, iconography, and motion. Build the guidelines and the components so the brand stays coherent as more people touch it.

  • Own the Coram website as the company's front door: design, art direction, and the ongoing craft of the pages that convert. Partner closely with demand gen and SEO on what ships.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Coram AI, we’re reimagining video security for the modern world. Our cloud-native platform uses computer vision and AI to help businesses stay safe, make smarter decisions, and move faster; from real-time alerts to seamless clip sharing and multi-site visibility.

You’ll be joining an ambitious, fast-moving team that values clarity, craftsmanship, and impact. Every person here has a voice, ships meaningful work, and helps shape how AI can make the world safer and more connected.

The role:

Coram builds physical security hardware: cameras, door-access controllers, intercoms. Real boxes that get screwed to walls in schools and offices, with electronics and AI inside them. The access-control line is already shipping and installed at customer sites. You inherit it, keep it healthy, and then build the next two product lines from concept to mass production: edge-enabled cameras and intercoms. We want both inside a year. The industry norm for a single hardware cycle is 9 to 12 months, so that target is deliberately aggressive.

The Hardware Engineering Manager is responsible for our Access Control product cateogory at Coram AI. Design happens in Sunnyvale. Manufacturing sits with specialist contract manufacturing partners, who build, test and certify the finished product to our design. That makes this role mostly engineering and part partnership management, across a long distance and several time zones. You will oversee a small design team here and a much larger group on the manufacturing side. Getting excellent product out of that arrangement is a craft, and it is the part of the role that matters most.

Responsibilities:

  • The shipping access-control line: quality, field performance, change control, ongoing cost

  • Two new product lines end to end. Concept, design, EVT through PVT, certification, ramp, mass production

  • The contract manufacturer relationship. You own it directly, including the design transfer package and everything in it

  • Hands-on engineering. CAD and drawings, or schematics and board bring-up, depending on where you spike

  • The processes the function runs on: stage gates, quality systems, supplier qualification, test protocols

Skills and qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in production mechanical or electrical engineering

  • Firsthand experience shipping a product through an external contract manufacturer at volume with the ability to talk in detail about the partner, the product and the numbers involved

  • Experience owning factory relationships directly versus passing off a design to a TPM or a manufacturing engineer at the transfer point

  • Experience owning a full design transfer package: CAD, BOM, assembly instructions, test procedures, quality criteria, drawings

  • Experience taking products through certification. FCC at minimum. CE and UL are relevant to what we build and advantageous to have familiarity with

The Role:

Our customers range from police departments and federal agencies to Fortune 500 companies, schools and hospitals, across the US, UK and Canada. Every one of them asks how we protect their data. You’ll make sure compliance never blocks a deal: you’ll own our certifications, lead customer security reviews, and turn policy into real, automated controls across the company. You’ll work directly with our engineering leadership and start hands-on. As we grow, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the function and the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Make compliance real: automate onboarding, offboarding and access reviews, and manage identity, SSO, MFA, device management and endpoint protection.

  • Own IT systems and vendors across our US, UK and India offices.

  • Work with engineering on security fixes and architecture changes, and lead incident response and customer communication when something goes wrong.

  • Build a prioritised security roadmap, report progress to leadership, and hire as the function grows.

  • 8+ years in security, compliance or IT, with ownership of a security and compliance programme at a B2B startup or scale-up.

  • Personally led a SOC 2 Type II audit, plus at least one more framework such as ISO 27001, HIPAA, CJIS, CMMC, ITAR or FedRAMP.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain tradeoffs plainly to reps, managers, executives, and partners and enforce process requirements when needed.

  • Strong ownership and judgment, with the ability to prioritize independently and balance long-term system improvements with immediate business needs.

  • Adaptability and resilience in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.

  • Ability to work on-site five days a week in Sunnyvale, CA.
